script: Three insane things young Japanese couples do on normal dates. First, they dress exactly like twins. They do not just wear matching colors; they will buy the exact same shirts, sneakers, and even bags just to walk around the city together. Next, they take photos that completely change their faces. They go into famous photo booths called Purikura. The machine automatically makes your eyes massive and your skin perfectly smooth, and you keep the printed stickers inside your phone case. But the absolute best part? The dates are super cheap. Instead of fancy romantic dinners, young couples will just go to a casual family restaurant, order a three-dollar pizza, and drink unlimited sodas from the drink machine for hours.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: Three insane things young Japanese couples do on normal dates.
